get.summary: The open "Needs attention" items of all modules.
get.description: Most severe first, then newest first; order=module gives the Today order (module order, then the order of each module's rules, T74). Each alert has the fields of a Today attention card, and raisedAt. The host checks the rules in the background; refresh=true checks them first (at most Alerts:RefreshWait).

get.summary: All cards of the Today screen, from all modules.
get.description: The finance (Money) cards come first. A module that fails gives no cards and has the status Failed. The host keeps a complete answer for a short time; refresh=true makes a new one (pull to refresh).

post.summary: Uploads a document: one or more files and its details.
post.description: multipart/form-data with the fields: files (one or more PDF, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, or WebP files), title (default: the name of the first file), kind (Receipt, Warranty, Lease, Tax, Insurance, Manual, Other; default Other), tags (repeat the field, or separate them with commas), issuedOn and expiresOn (yyyy-MM-dd), and notes. The answer comes at once, with ocrStatus Pending: the OCR runs in the background.

get.summary: A page of documents, newest first (best match first with q).
get.description: Filters: kind, tag, q (full-text search in the title, the tags, the notes, and the OCR text; web search syntax: "exact phrase", -word), expiresFrom and expiresTo (yyyy-MM-dd, both included), expiring=soon (from today, in the host's time zone, to Documents:Expiry:SoonDays ahead; T86).

get.summary: The documents linked to one thing, for example ?kind=Money.Transaction&id=<transaction id>.

post.summary: How many documents link to each of some things (at most 200), for example the transactions of a page (T72).
post.description: Body: { kind, targetIds }. The answer has every requested id, in its stored form, with its count (0 included).

get.summary: One document, with its OCR text.

put.summary: Changes the details of a document (all of them). The files stay.

delete.summary: Deletes a document, its links, and its files (a file stays while another document has the same content).

get.summary: The content of one file. inline=true shows it in the browser; the default is a download.

post.summary: Runs the OCR of a document again, in the background (ocrStatus Pending).
Links the document to something outside the module, for example { "kind": "Money.Transaction", "targetId": "<id>" }.
post.description: For a finance transaction, the host checks with finance that the transaction exists (as the signed-in user).

delete.summary: Removes a link of the document.

get.summary: The item count, the total value, the count per room, and the warranties that end in the next 30 days.
All maintenance: the open tasks linked to an item from either side, by due date (T89).
The categories in use, by name, with the count of items in each (T89).
All rooms in list order, with the item count and the total value of each.

post.summary: Adds a room. The name is required and unique (any letter case; 409 for a name that exists).

put.summary: A new order of the rooms: { "roomIds": [ all room ids, in the new order ] }.
Renames a room, or moves it in the list (sortOrder).

delete.summary: Deletes a room without items. A room with items gets 409.

post.summary: Adds an item. Only the name is required.
post.description: Amounts are plain decimals in the one app currency, for one item (the value of the row is multiplied by quantity). purchasedOn and warrantyUntil are days (yyyy-MM-dd). links are { kind, targetId } (Documents.Document, Money.Transaction, or Tasks.Task); the host checks that each one exists.

get.summary: A page of items, by name (with q: best match first).
get.description: Filters: room (a room id, or none), category (any letter case), tag, q (full-text search in the name, the brand, the model, the serial number, the category, the notes, and the tags), warranty (active: ends today or later; expiring: ends in the next 30 days; expired: ended before today).

get.summary: All items (or the items of the same filters as the list) as a CSV file for an insurance claim.
get.description: UTF-8 with a byte order mark. Columns: Room, Name, Category, Brand, Model, Serial number, Quantity, Purchase date, Purchase price, Current value, Warranty until, Documents (the titles, with "; ").

get.summary: The items of one thing, for example ?kind=Documents.Document&id=<document id>.
get.description: Also the items that the document or the task links to (kind Home.Item).

get.summary: One item, with its links, its documents, and its maintenance tasks.

put.summary: Changes the details of an item (all of them). The links stay.

delete.summary: Deletes an item and its links. Documents and tasks lose their links to it.

post.summary: Links the item to a document, a task, or a finance transaction, for example { "kind": "Documents.Document", "targetId": "<id>" }.
post.description: The host checks that the thing exists. For a transaction it asks finance as the signed-in user (502 when finance does not answer).

delete.summary: Removes a link of the item.

get.summary: Today's entry, the streak, the last 7 days, and "On this day" (the same day in earlier years).
A page of entries, newest first (with q: best match first).
get.description: q: words in the text (web search syntax: "a phrase", -not). from, to: days, both included.

get.summary: The entry of one day (yyyy-MM-dd). 404 when the day has none.

put.summary: Writes the whole text of one day: 201 for a new entry, 200 for a change.
put.description: The text is required (at most 20000 characters). A day after today is refused (400).

delete.summary: Deletes the entry of one day.

get.summary: The person count, the people to reach out to, the birthdays in the next 30 days, and the open loans.
The groups in use, by name, with the count of people in each.
A page of people, by name (sort=contact: the reach-out day, soonest first).
get.description: Filters: group (any letter case), q (words in the name, the nickname, the relationship, the groups, the email, the phone, and the notes).

post.summary: Adds a person. Only the name is required.
post.description: birthday is { month, day, year? }. contactEveryDays (1 to 3650) is the reach-out reminder. links are { kind, targetId } (Documents.Document, Money.Transaction, Tasks.Task, or Home.Item).

get.summary: The people of one thing, for example ?kind=Home.Item&id=<item id>.
One person, with the latest contacts, the gift ideas, the loans, and the links.

put.summary: Changes the details of a person (all of them). The records and the links stay.

delete.summary: Deletes a person with the contacts, the gift ideas, the loans, and the links.

post.summary: Links the person to a document, a task, a home item, or a finance transaction.
post.description: The host checks that the thing exists. For a transaction it asks finance as the signed-in user (502 when finance does not answer).

delete.summary: Removes a link of the person.

get.summary: A page of the contacts with a person, newest first.

post.summary: Logs a contact (default: today). It moves the last contact of the person.
Adds a gift idea (with givenOn: a given gift).

put.summary: Changes a gift idea (all values). Set givenOn when the gift was given.

get.summary: The loans of all people: status=open (default), returned, or all. Open loans by due day first.

post.summary: Adds a thing lent to the person (direction Lent, default) or borrowed from the person (Borrowed).

put.summary: Changes a loan (all values). Set returnedOn when the thing came back.

post.summary: Adds a task. Only the title is required.
post.description: dueOn is a day (yyyy-MM-dd). repeat is { every, unit (Days, Weeks, Months, Years), mode (FromDueDate, the default, or FromCompletion) }; a repeated task without dueOn is due today. links are { kind, targetId } (Documents.Document or Money.Transaction); the host checks that each one exists.

get.summary: A page of tasks: by due date (tasks without one last), then the manual order; done tasks: the last done first.
get.description: Filters: status (Open, Done), tag, due (today; overdue: open and due before today; upcoming: the next 7 days after today; later: after those days; none: no due date), q (words in the title, the notes, or the tags). "Today" is in the time zone of the host (Tasks:TimeZone).

get.summary: The counts of open tasks due today, overdue, and upcoming (7 days), for the badges.
The tags in use, by name, with the count of tasks (open and done) that have each one.
The tasks linked to one thing, for example ?kind=Documents.Document&id=<document id>.
One task, with its last 10 completions.

put.summary: Changes the details of a task (all of them). The status, the completions, and the links stay.

delete.summary: Deletes a task, its completions, and its links.

post.summary: Marks a task done. A repeated task stays open, with its next due date.
post.description: A task that is done already gets 409.

post.summary: Undoes the last "done": the task is open again, or a repeated task gets its old due date back.
post.description: A task without a completion gets 409.

post.summary: Links the task to a document or a finance transaction, for example { "kind": "Documents.Document", "targetId": "<id>" }.
post.description: The host checks that the thing exists. For a transaction it asks finance as the signed-in user (502 when finance does not answer).

delete.summary: Removes a link of the task.
